# Municipal Ordinance No. 11, Series of 2024

**An Ordinance Establishing Guidelines for the Accreditation of Civil Society Organization (CSO), Non-Governmental Organization (NGO), People's Organization (POs) and Professional Groups Within the Jurisdiction of the Municipality of Pitogo**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes the guidelines and procedures for the accreditation of civil society organizations (CSOs), non-governmental organizations (NGOs), people's organizations (POs), and professional groups operating within the jurisdiction of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]]. The accreditation framework enables these organizations to participate in local governance processes as mandated by the [[Local Government Code]]. The ordinance was reviewed and declared **valid** by the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] under SP Resolution No. 2024-1056.

## Key Provisions

- Establishes an accreditation system for CSOs, NGOs, POs, and professional groups
- Defines eligibility criteria and documentary requirements for accreditation
- Sets the procedures for application, evaluation, and approval of accreditation
- Specifies the rights and responsibilities of accredited organizations
- Enables participation of accredited organizations in local special bodies and governance processes
- Provides for the periodic renewal and review of accreditation status

## Provincial Review

The [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] of [[Quezon Province]] reviewed this ordinance under **SP Resolution No. 2024-1056** dated November 18, 2024, and declared it **VALID**. The ordinance was found to be consistent with the provisions of RA 7160 on the role of civil society and people's organizations in local governance.
